title: Cruickshank's archival research into Kennedy records and MJ12

tellings.quote: like Jeff Krookshank have done a little bit have done like the forensic historical kind of uh deep dive look through the Kennedy archives

plain: Matthew Pines, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says some researchers, including Jeff Cruickshank, have done careful historical digging through the records of President John F. Kennedy from the 1960s, which have since been made public. According to Pines, they looked for links to the MJ12 documents, papers said to concern a secret group handling UFO matters. If such links held up, it would tie a US president to secret UFO work.
